title: This show is a SAFETY HAZZARD and needs to be shut down IMMEDIATELY! ...
transcript: So I was at the first preview of Peter Pan Goes Wrong. I really didn't know much about it other than, like, it was a retelling Peter Pan, and, like, maybe some wacky things happen. Um, and I debated whether or not to make this TikTok because it's 1/1 preview, and obviously it can't be expected to run completely smoothly. Um, and I was so weird commenting on those things because things can change before opening night. But I decided to make it because this was one of the most unprofessional shows I have ever sat through. Like, the amount of things that did not go as planned was crazy. Like, there were sets falling apart, there were props breaking. There were actors forgetting their lines for getting their cues. Lighting was going off at the wrong time. Like, sound cues were going off at the wrong time. Like, it was almost like everything that could go wrong did go wrong. And I was just sitting here like, I paid a Broadway prices for this. And, like, you're just clearly not prepared. And also, this show is a complete safety hazard. Like, it needs to be shut down immediately. There were multiple, multiple cast injuries during the show, and they. They looked very serious. And the worst part was the audience was laughing. Like, a guy just fell from 3 stories and everyone's laughing, and I was like, this poor guy. Like, thankfully he ended up being okay, but, like, Imagine if you went to the hospital or like, god forbid, like, died, and the audience is laughing at this guy's pain. I could not believe. I mean, audience behavior I feel like has been on the decline over the past like year or 2 since Broadway reopened, but like, this is an all time low. I was just stunned by the lack of professionalism, the lack of. Of really any confidence on that stage. I cannot in good conscious recommend this one. Unless for some reason you enjoy watching things go poorly when you watch a show. But probably not you. So don't go see this one.
